desc: Designed to minimize the number of illuminators an operator must carry, the low-profile Sidewinder Stalk provides ultimate maneuverability, multiple mounting options, and a flexible stalk to aim the beam. Multi-fuel capability allows it to accept more than one battery type. Features visible white, multi-colored, and IR LEDs. In addition, a separate Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) switch lets you use both the main light and IFF when needed.
